sourceChecks.scope: Supports beginner paradigms and sample contexts; not advanced information structure or all senses of each particle.

semanticReview.method: Seguimiento de fuentes: consulta de diccionarios y materiales académicos/institucionales abiertos; cotejo de localizadores explícitos y alcance. La evidencia parcial no se convirtió en VERIFIED.
findings: La entrada oficial distingue 없다 para no existencia, falta/tener y localización (incluida la forma 이이 없다 y ejemplos); esto mejora la evidencia previa, pero los matices de traducción contextual de 시간이 없다/의자가 없다 siguen abiertos.
limitations: Fuente lexicográfica primaria y tabla pedagógica cubren solo parcialmente el artículo; Evidence canónica no creada, assessEntry no ejecutado.

followupSources.title: 없다
followupSources.reference: National Institute of Korean Language. (n.d.). 없다. Korean-English Learners’ Dictionary. https://krdict.korean.go.kr/eng/dicSearch/SearchView?ParaNationCode=6&ParaWordNo=89917&nation=eng&nationCode=6
followupSources.locator: Senses 1, 6–8 and 11 (HTML lines 340–358, 366–368, 450–481): nonexistence, inability, absence at a location and lack/possession; examples 책이 없다 and 돈이 없다.
followupSources.supports: The existential/location and possession readings are distinct senses of 없다, and the verb can mean inability in -ㄹ/을 수 없다.
followupSources.limitation: Does not settle the Spanish translation in every context or independently validate all 이/가 alternations and article examples.
